newsHighlights.title: The Long March inspires generations to keep going further
newsHighlights.summary: Decades after the Red Army's epic march, the spirit of perseverance continues to inspire young Chinese to push their limits and pursue lifelong growth.
newsHighlights.translation: 在红军史诗般的长征过去数十年后，坚持不懈的长征精神继续激励着中国年轻人挑战极限、追求终身成长。

newsHighlights.title: Red Army descendants carry forward Long March spirit
newsHighlights.summary: Descendants of Red Army soldiers are passing down stories of sacrifice and resilience, teaching younger generations the value of courage and duty.
newsHighlights.translation: 红军战士的后代正在传承牺牲与坚韧的故事，向年轻一代传授勇气与责任的价值。

newsHighlights.title: AI accessibility empowering ordinary people
newsHighlights.summary: As artificial intelligence becomes more accessible, ordinary workers and students are using it to learn new skills and improve productivity.
newsHighlights.translation: 随着人工智能日益普及，普通劳动者和学生正在利用它学习新技能、提升效率。

newsHighlights.title: Net FDI inflows in first half hit four-year high
newsHighlights.summary: Net foreign direct investment inflows into China reached the highest first-half level in four years, reflecting growing foreign investor confidence.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国上半年净外商直接投资流入达到四年来的最高水平，反映出外国投资者信心不断增强。

newsHighlights.title: China-EU vehicle trade deal benefits both
newsHighlights.summary: The consensus reached by China and the EU on hybrid and electric vehicle trade safeguards the interests of both sides and prevents frictions from escalating.
newsHighlights.translation: 中欧就混合动力与电动汽车贸易达成的共识，维护了双方利益，并防止贸易摩擦升级。

quote.quote: The Long March is a manifesto. It has proclaimed to the world that the Red Army is an army of heroes.
quote.author: Mao Zedong
quote.translation: 长征是宣言书。它向全世界宣告，红军是英雄的军队。
quote.explanation: 长征被视为信念与毅力的象征。这句话提醒我们：真正的成长往往来自艰难跋涉的过程，而非终点；只要坚持前行，困难的经历就会成为向世界证明自己的宣言书。

vocabulary.definition: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的；适应力强的
vocabulary.example: The Chinese economy is shifting toward more resilient growth, creating confidence among young job seekers.
vocabulary.translation: 中国经济正转向更具韧性的发展，给年轻求职者带来信心。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《Net FDI inflows in first half hit four-year high》：“as the Chinese economy shifts toward more resilient growth”。

vocabulary.example: The Long March inspires generations of students to keep going further in their studies.
vocabulary.translation: 长征激励着一代代学生在学业上不断走得更远。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题《The Long March inspires generations to keep going further》。

vocabulary.example: Red Army descendants carry forward the spirit of courage and self-discipline.
vocabulary.translation: 红军后代传承着勇气与自律的精神。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《Red Army descendants carry forward Long March spirit》。

vocabulary.example: Every generation should carry forward the values it has inherited from its predecessors.
vocabulary.translation: 每一代人都应发扬从先辈那里继承的价值观。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《Red Army descendants carry forward Long March spirit》。

vocabulary.example: AI accessibility is empowering ordinary people to learn new skills on their own.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能的普及正在赋能普通人自主学习新技能。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《AI accessibility empowering ordinary people》。

vocabulary.definition: 可及性；易获得性；可访问性
vocabulary.example: Greater accessibility to online courses has changed how students learn.
vocabulary.translation: 在线课程更易获得，改变了学生的学习方式。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《AI accessibility empowering ordinary people》。

vocabulary.example: Repeated practice builds the confidence learners need to face bigger challenges.
vocabulary.translation: 反复练习能建立起学习者应对更大挑战所需的信心。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《Net FDI inflows in first half hit four-year high》：“reflecting growing foreign investor confidence”。

vocabulary.example: The class reached a consensus that daily reading matters more than last-minute cramming.
vocabulary.translation: 全班达成共识：每日阅读比临时抱佛脚更重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《China-EU vehicle trade deal benefits both》：“The consensus reached by China and the European Union...”。

vocabulary.example: Good habits safeguard your progress when motivation runs low.
vocabulary.translation: 当动力不足时，良好的习惯能守护你的进步。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻《China-EU vehicle trade deal benefits both》：“effectively safeguards the interests of Chinese companies”。

vocabulary.example: Once you build momentum in reading every day, learning becomes much easier.
vocabulary.translation: 一旦养成每日阅读的势头，学习就会变得容易得多。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻《Net FDI inflows in first half hit four-year high》与《Rebuilt port opens to boost connectivity》，报道中强调中国经济与互联互通的持续增长势头。

pattern.pattern: prevent / stop + 宾语 + from + doing（阻止……发生/防止……升级）
pattern.example: The deal effectively safeguards the interests of Chinese companies and prevents bilateral trade frictions from escalating.
pattern.translation: 该协议有效维护了中国企业的利益，并防止双边贸易摩擦升级。
pattern.usage: 用于表达“阻止某人/某事做某事”。注意 from 后接动词 -ing 形式。近义结构有 keep/stop/protect...from doing。例如：Reading every day prevents your skills from getting rusty.（每天阅读能防止技能生疏。）

grammar.title: 现在分词作结果/伴随状语（Present Participle as Adverbial）
grammar.explanation: 当主句描述一个动作或状态，其结果、伴随情况或补充说明用另一个动词表达时，常用“动词-ing”形式放在句首、句中或句末，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。这种结构在英文新闻中极为常见，可使句子更紧凑。
examples: Net foreign direct investment inflows reached the highest first-half level in four years, reflecting growing foreign investor confidence.
The Long March inspires generations of young people, encouraging them to keep going further.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 -sil- 上，读作 ri-ZIL-ee-ənt。/ɪ/ 为短元音，舌尖靠近下齿；/liənt/ 处 /l/ 要清晰，结尾 /ənt/ 弱读，不要读成“利恩特”。可先慢读 rɪ-zɪl-i-ənt，再连读。
examples: The resilient economy continues to attract foreign investment.
Resilient learners treat failure as part of the process.

reading.title: The Long March Spirit: Learning to Keep Going Further
reading.content:
More than 90 years ago, the Red Army completed the Long March, one of the most difficult journeys in modern history. Today, its spirit still speaks loudly to students and young professionals.

Red Army descendants are passing down stories of courage and self-discipline, reminding us that growth rarely comes easily. In much the same way, the Chinese economy has shown resilient strength, with net FDI inflows hitting a four-year high and a rebuilt port opening to boost connectivity. Steady progress, not sudden success, is what builds real momentum.

Technology is opening new doors as well. Greater AI accessibility is empowering ordinary people to learn new skills and improve productivity, no matter where they live. Meanwhile, the China-EU vehicle trade consensus shows that dialogue can safeguard shared interests and prevent conflicts from escalating.

The lesson is simple: keep walking, keep learning. Every difficult step forward becomes a manifesto of who you are becoming.
reading.translation:
90多年前，红军完成了长征——现代史上最艰难的旅程之一。今天，长征精神依然向学生和年轻职场人发出响亮的呼唤。

红军后代传承着勇气与自律的故事，提醒我们成长从来都不轻松。同样，中国经济展现出韧性：上半年净外商直接投资流入达到四年高位，重建的口岸开通以促进互联互通。真正积累起势头的是稳步前进，而非一朝成名。

技术也在开启新的大门。人工智能日益普及，赋能普通人学习新技能、提高效率，无论身在何处。与此同时，中欧电动汽车贸易共识表明，对话能够维护共同利益，防止冲突升级。

道理很简单：继续走，继续学。你向前迈出的每一步艰难路程，都会成为你成长的宣言书。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026-10-13 ChinaDaily 真实新闻《The Long March inspires generations to keep going further》《Red Army descendants carry forward Long March spirit》《Net FDI inflows in first half hit four-year high》《AI accessibility empowering ordinary people》《China-EU vehicle trade deal benefits both》改写，供英语学习使用。
